definitions.explanation: A stone monument or marker erected to commemorate and console the spirits of the deceased, especially victims of war, disasters, or accidents.

examples.japanese: {慰霊碑|いれいひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祈|いの}った→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.english: I prayed in front of the memorial monument.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}→戦没者：23238_senbotsusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{慰霊碑|いれいひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: A memorial monument was erected for those who died in the war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{八月|はちがつ}→八月：00626_hachigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{広島|ひろしま}→広島：28985_hiroshima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{慰霊碑|いれいひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手向|たむ}ける。
examples.english: Every August, many people lay flowers at the memorial monument in Hiroshima.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{慰霊|いれい}→慰霊：22918_irei⟧ (consolation of spirits; memorial) + {碑|ひ} (stone monument). Deeply connected to Japanese memorial culture, especially post-war remembrance. Found at battle sites, disaster locations, and places of historical tragedy. The concept of ⟦{慰霊|いれい}→慰霊：22918_irei⟧ reflects the belief in consoling the spirits of the dead so they may rest in peace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慰霊碑|いれいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧: to erect a memorial monument
- {慰霊碑|いれいひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧: to offer flowers at a memorial
- {慰霊碑|いれいひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{黙祷|もくとう}→黙祷：17408_mokutou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to observe a moment of silence at a memorial
- ⟦{戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}→戦没者：23238_senbotsusha⟧{慰霊碑|いれいひ}: war dead memorial

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {記念碑|きねんひ}: monument; commemorative stele — broader; can commemorate any event or achievement, not necessarily death
- ⟦{墓石|ぼせき}→墓石：27326_boseki⟧: gravestone; tombstone — marks an individual grave rather than serving as a collective memorial
- ⟦{慰霊祭|いれいさい}→慰霊祭：27133_ireisai⟧: memorial service — the ceremony rather than the physical monument
